fact: A presidential order of 23 January 2025 authorised USD 4,778,500 for specialist consultancy to modernise the Ministry of Finance's IT infrastructure and solutions, stating the current SETIC-FP system needs functional restructuring and a more up-to-date system for revenue collection and spending control.
title: Decreto Presidencial n.º 40/25 de 13 de fevereiro
publisher: Presidente da República de Angola, Diário da República I Série n.º 29
